تحتجمون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَجِمُونَ (taḥtajimūna) /taħ.ta.d͡ʒi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# تُحْتَجَمُونَ (tuḥtajamūna) /tuħ.ta.d͡ʒa.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
